name: Thinly layered delta outcrop
interpretation: Fine-grained prodelta or distal lacustrine deposits
positionNote: Representative type location published to 0.001°. This is coordinate rounding, not measured positional accuracy or a precise sample location.
citation: Stack et al. (2020), Photogeologic Map of the Perseverance Rover Field Site in Jezero Crater, Table 2; DOI 10.1007/s11214-020-00739-x
coordinateNote: Table heading says lat/lon but numerical pairs are longitude then latitude, consistent with the paper's Jezero mapping extent (~77°E, ~18°N). Stored as east longitude, north latitude.

name: Thickly layered delta outcrop
interpretation: Deltaic channel lobes, toe deposits or floodplain deposits
positionNote: Representative type location published to 0.001°. Coordinate precision does not establish positional accuracy or safe access.
coordinateNote: Published numerical pairs interpreted as longitude, latitude against the Jezero mapping extent.

name: Curvilinear delta outcrop
interpretation: Point bars or subaqueous channel-levee deposits
positionNote: Representative type location published to 0.001°. The outcrop type point is not a confirmed sampling site.
coordinateNote: Published numerical pairs interpreted as longitude, latitude against the Jezero mapping extent.
